one_liner: CLI that renders Mermaid diagram definitions into SVG, PNG, or PDF files.

evidence.claim: Mermaid CLI is a local command-line tool that converts Mermaid diagram files to SVG/PNG/PDF; no account or credentials needed
evidence.quote: It takes a mermaid definition file as input and generates an SVG/PNG/PDF file as output.

evidence.claim: Free self-serve install via npm with no signup or auth
Programmatic use is possible via a Node.js API, though it is not semver-stable
evidence.quote: It's possible to call mermaid-cli via a Node.JS API. Please be aware that the NodeJS API is not covered by semver

evidence.claim: Open source under the MIT license
The vendor's own docs site documents an official Mermaid MCP Server
evidence.quote: The Mermaid MCP Server enables AI assistants to create, validate, and render Mermaid diagrams seamlessly

notes: Not a hosted web API: it is a local CLI/Node library (mmdc), so there is no auth, token, or developer account at all. The official MCP server lives on mermaid.ai and mentions 'full integration with your Mermaid Chart account', i.e. it is tied to the commercial Mermaid Chart product rather than the mermaid-cli repo itself. NodeJS API explicitly not covered by semver.
